tasks: fine-grained edits, formatting and schema preparation

effort_rules.none: Only an exact deterministic transform with an independent validator and no judgment-bearing output.
effort_rules.medium: Clear multi-file coordination without consequential judgment.

escalate_when: the task requires scientific judgment or source synthesis
the task becomes ambiguous, consequential or cross-system
a deterministic check exposes a material conflict

tasks: everyday coding, research and evidence synthesis
fact checking, document review and bounded implementation
complex coding, computer use and professional workflows below the Astra exception boundary

effort_rules.low: Focused writing, editing, fact checking or straightforward application work.
effort_rules.medium: Default for research, coding and workflows requiring judgment and completeness.
effort_rules.high: Independent scientific or visual review, deep verification, complex debugging or consequential acceptance.
effort_rules.xhigh: Only when a representative evaluation shows a measurable gain for deep analysis, careful review or unresolved architecture.
effort_rules.max: Exceptional only: Human PI authorization plus representative evidence that xhigh is insufficient for a consequential decision.

escalate_when: an L3, irreversible or scope-expanding decision requires the project's architecture owner
multiple systems retain unresolved authority or evidence conflicts after a bounded Sol/high review
representative evaluation shows Astra materially improves the consequential outcome

tasks: L3 planning and exception adjudication after lower routes are insufficient
broad-context integration and consequential L3 preparation
exacting deliverables when lower routes are insufficient

effort_rules.low: Concise adaptation that must preserve facts and nuance; prefer Luna or Sol when they are sufficient.
effort_rules.medium: Default for broad-context architecture and ambitious multi-step work.
effort_rules.high: Consequential architecture, failure analysis or exacting integration review.
effort_rules.xhigh: Only when representative evaluations show a clear benefit, or the Human PI explicitly authorizes the added cost and latency.

required_before_adoption: official model capability and pricing review
representative task evaluation for changed model or effort
